legal.mentions.cookies_desc: The platform only uses the cookies strictly necessary for its operation and security (session, CSRF protection). No advertising or tracking cookies are placed.
legal.mentions.hosting_desc: The platform is hosted by alwaysdata, a hosting provider whose servers may be located outside your country. Data transfers are governed by the appropriate contractual guarantees provided for by the GDPR.
legal.mentions.ip_desc: All content, interfaces and code on the platform are the exclusive property of the publisher and are protected by intellectual property law. Any total or partial reproduction or representation without authorization is prohibited.
legal.mentions.publisher_desc: The publication is managed by the legal representative of the publisher.
legal.mentions.title: Legal Notice
legal.privacy.breach_desc: In the event of a data breach likely to create a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will inform you and the competent supervisory authority within the timeframes required by law.
legal.privacy.data_desc: We collect only the data strictly necessary for your care: identity, contact details, and — for patients — the health information shared by you or your healthcare professionals. We also record technical logs (IP address, browser) for security.
legal.privacy.legal_basis_desc: Your data is processed on the basis of: your explicit consent (recorded at registration), performance of your care contract, and our legal obligation to retain certain health data.
legal.privacy.retention_desc: Health data is kept for the legal period applicable to the retention of medical records, then deleted or anonymized. Audit logs are kept for traceability purposes. You may request early deletion of your account at any time.
legal.privacy.rights_desc: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure (right to be forgotten), portability, objection and restriction of processing. You may also withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise your rights, contact us at the address above or via your dashboard.
legal.privacy.security_desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: password encryption, two-factor authentication, access logging, and role- and permission-based access controls.
legal.privacy.sharing_desc: Your data is only shared with the healthcare professionals and laboratories you have authorized, and never for commercial purposes. It may be transmitted to the competent authorities when required by law.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
legal.terms.account_desc: You must provide accurate and up-to-date information. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your login credentials. Any activity carried out from your account is attributed to you. The publisher reserves the right to suspend any account in case of fraud or abusive use.
legal.terms.governing_law_desc: These Terms are subject to the law applicable at the publisher's registered office. Any dispute shall be submitted, failing amicable resolution, to the competent courts.
legal.terms.health_data_desc: Health data is sensitive data within the meaning of the GDPR. It is only processed with your consent, is strictly confidential, and is never transferred to third parties for commercial purposes. See our
legal.terms.liability_desc: Medix eSanté does its utmost to ensure the availability and security of the platform, without this constituting an obligation of result. The publisher cannot be held responsible for the consequences of misuse of the information shared by its users.
legal.terms.object_desc: These Terms and Conditions of Use govern access to and use of the Medix eSanté platform, which connects patients, doctors and medical testing laboratories. By creating an account, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted these terms.
legal.terms.termination_desc: You can delete your account and your data at any time, in accordance with the right to erasure (see the privacy policy). In the event of a breach of these Terms, the publisher may suspend or terminate your access.
legal.terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
legal.terms.usage_desc: The platform allows the sharing of medical data between healthcare professionals and patients, strictly within the scope of medical care and with the patient's explicit consent. It is prohibited to use the platform for unlawful purposes or contrary to medical ethics.
